title: Associate
cities: Germany (Berlin, Cologne, Dusseldorf, Frankfurt, Hamburg, Munich, Stuttgart, Vienna)
whoYouWillWorkWith:
Driving lasting impact and building long-term capabilities with our clients is not easy work. You are the kind of person who thrives in a high performance/high reward culture - doing hard things, picking yourself up when you stumble, and having the resilience to try another way forward.
In return for your drive, determination, and curiosity, we'll provide the resources, mentorship, and opportunities you need to become a stronger leader faster than you ever thought possible. Your colleagues—at all levels—will invest deeply in your development, just as much as they invest in delivering exceptional results for clients. Every day, you'll receive apprenticeship, coaching, and exposure that will accelerate your growth in ways you won’t find anywhere else.
When you join us, you will have:
  • Continuous learning: Our learning and apprenticeship culture, backed by structured programs, is all about helping you grow while creating an environment where feedback is clear, actionable, and focused on your development. The real magic happens when you take the input from others to heart and embrace the fast-paced learning experience, owning your journey.
  • A voice that matters: From day one, we value your ideas and contributions. You’ll make a tangible impact by offering innovative ideas and practical solutions, all while upholding our unwavering commitment to ethics and integrity. We not only encourage diverse perspectives, but they are critical in driving us toward the best possible outcomes.
  • Global community: With colleagues across 65+ countries and over 100 different nationalities, our firm’s diversity fuels creativity and helps us come up with the best solutions for our clients. Plus, you’ll have the opportunity to learn from exceptional colleagues with diverse backgrounds and experiences.
  • World-class benefits: On top of a competitive salary (based on your location, experience, and skills), we provide a comprehensive benefits package to enable holistic well-being for you and your family.
whatYouWillDo:
As an associate, you will join a client service team and take ownership of a workstream to solve some of the toughest challenges our clients face.  
And these aren’t just any clients—they're some of the most influential organizations around, from Fortune 500 giants to innovative startups. We will expect you to go the extra mile, delivering solutions that solve immediate problems and drive long-term change. And we’ll rely on your judgment and integrity to ensure our recommendations are effective and long-lasting.
You will take on a role that goes beyond advising. You’ll be at the heart of the action—helping to uncover the true challenges behind a client’s strategy and creating actionable plans that drive real change. Working alongside clients and other McKinsey colleagues, you’ll combine research, analyzing data, interviews, and brainstorming to generate fresh insights and breakthrough solutions. Your commitment to our values will be crucial in earning our clients' trust and delivering results that matter.
As you collaborate directly with clients, you’ll help them solve problems, refine strategies, and implement transformations. By equipping them with the tools and knowledge to continue innovating and improving after we’ve left, you’ll ensure the impact of our work endures. In doing so, you’ll uphold McKinsey’s commitment to making a meaningful difference in the industries and communities we serve.
yourBackground:
• Typically, an advanced graduate degree (e.g., MBA, PhD, etc.) or equivalent work experience; Requirements may vary by country or practice.
  • Excellent organization capabilities, including the ability to initiate tasks independently and see them through to completion.
  • Strong communication skills, both verbal and written, in English and local office language(s), with the ability to adjust your style to suit different perspectives and seniority levels.
  • Proficient in rational decision making based on data, facts, and logical reasoning.
  • Ability to create work product-focused materials / outputs, which may include PowerPoint decks, Excel models, articles, or other written deliverables.
  • Exceptional time management to meet your responsibilities in a complex and largely autonomous work environment.
  • Ability to work or attend meetings outside of traditional business hours or take on projects with limited or no notice at times.
  • Ability to travel to and work in varying environments that may be challenging and/or not accessible (e.g., factories, hospitals, mines).

In this role, you will serve clients with the MT recipe of leveraging a holistic, execution-centric approach, providing interim management and transformation leadership capabilities and integrating the best of the firm. To achieve proven results, you will apply all levers, not only cost but also including revenue, strategy, organization and capital. Your client engagements will often span 12 to 24 months, and they will include three phases: independent diligence phase (6-8 weeks), bottom-up phase (6-8 weeks) and implementation (6-12+ months).
Specifically, you will operate as a project manager for one or more of these phases and you will manage a team of consultants focused on a T&T engagement. By combining a strategic perspective with disciplined implementation, you will lead this team to identify the strategic, operational, organizational and financial levers that will deliver rapid and dramatic client impact. Throughout this process, you will apply our results-oriented and proprietary MT solutions which are backed by tools, benchmarks and methodologies.
You will be responsible for delivering the right transformation process, integrating it across multiple workstreams, establishing the right mindset based on the latest performance and mobilizing the entire business to achieve and sustain value. You will also be responsible for ensuring that the team fully and properly leverages the capabilities of MT globally across both MT service lines.
More broadly, you will be responsible for the overall execution and success of these large-scale turnarounds and transformations. You will leverage a broad range of leadership and influencing styles, ranging from respected manager to motivational senior coach, and you will display high energy and resilience in ambiguous and fast-paced contexts. Occasionally, you will play an interim management role for the client as well.
MT is a unit of McKinsey, founded in 2010, that focuses exclusively on holistic transformations and corporate restructuring. We help clients drive rapid and dramatic performance improvement, plus provide a full suite of services to support companies facing liquidity issues or insolvency. To do so, we pair experienced professionals who are drawn from industry, private equity, and the restructuring ecosystem with our firm’s global network of industry and functional experts.
MT has two service lines: Turnarounds & Transformations (T&T) and Corporate Restructuring (CR). While the CR service line focuses on leading complex corporate restructuring programs at companies facing acute performance issues, liquidity concerns, potential covenant violations, and other issues that are destabilizing to the enterprise, the T&T service line focuses on driving rapid performance improvement for any business with significant performance improvement potential and an aspirational leader (ranging from distressed to “good to great” situations).
We are doers, and we work closely with clients to execute the steps needed to achieve extraordinary performance improvements. With ~150 dedicated MT consultants and ~250 generalist consultants among our global affiliates, we serve clients in more than 50 countries, many of which are among the largest impact situations for the firm globally.

  • Robust understanding of financial and operational levers (e.g. business plan modeling, working capital management, financial statement analysis)
  • Experience in strategic consulting is strongly preferred

  • Excellent problem solving and stakeholder engagement skills

You will participate in the client development lifecycle in three phases: business development, which includes all activities that occur before a client organization has decided internally to move ahead with a consulting engagement on a given topic; capture management, which begins once an opportunity has been qualified and ends with the formal award decision; and proposal delivery, which typically starts with the request for proposal (RFP) or equivalent procurement release and ends upon proposal submission.

The business development phase will comprise a significant portion of your effort, and examples of what you’ll do in this phase include: conducting white- and grey-space client ecosystem analyses, identifying potential opportunities, performing budget and legislative tear-downs, market sensing, competitive and market intelligence gathering, and providing recommendations to strengthen positioning and shape opportunities. You will conduct extensive research to collect data on competitors, industry trends, and the broader consulting landscape. Using your deep industry knowledge and analytical expertise, you will deliver strategic recommendations that drive impact, including constructing and managing go-to-market campaigns that amplify McKinsey’s insights and capabilities that align with emerging client needs.
This will involve working closely with McKinsey’s service lines to identify client priorities, utilizing business intelligence tools and software for data collection, analysis, and visualization, as well as translating complex data into clear, actionable insights and strategic guidance. You will construct comprehensive client account plans and manage the client opportunity pipeline. Other responsibilities include establishing relationships with other consultancies and contractors with whom McKinsey might partner in service to the government; supporting client teams in the development of written materials for client development discussions; attending conferences and industry days where public sector contracting opportunities might be discussed; gathering intelligence about upcoming procurements for which McKinsey might be well suited to compete; making recommendations to client team leaders about how they could more effectively develop business with clients.

You will work closely with SHaPE Practice leaders, client team leaders and consultants serving US State & Local government clients. You will also work collaboratively with other client development advisors, contracting specialists and proposal managers.

 Along the way, you will receive best-in-class training in structuring business problems and serving as a client adviser, develop tech-skills through (in-person) trainings curated by big-tech companies, and have opportunities to work closely with and learn from our senior agriculture and nature leaders and industry players that are shaping the future of these fields. whatYouWillDo:

Dabei handelt es sich um einige der einflussreichsten Organisationen weltweit, von Fortune-500- und DAX-Unternehmen bis hin zu innovativen Start-ups. Bei uns wirst du gefordert – und gefördert. Du erarbeitest Lösungen für aktuelle und drängende Problemstellungen und treibst langfristige Veränderung an. Wir vertrauen auf dein Urteilsvermögen und deine Zuverlässigkeit, um sicherzustellen, dass unsere Empfehlungen wirksam und nachhaltig sind.
Du bist vor Ort beim Klienten und hilfst dabei, die wesentlichen Herausforderungen hinter einer Strategie zu ergründen und realisierbare Maßnahmen zu entwickeln. Gemeinsam mit unseren Klienten und deinen McKinsey-Kolleg:innen kombinierst du Research, Datenanalyse, Interviews und Brainstorming, um neue Erkenntnisse und innovative Lösungen zu erarbeiten. Mit deinem Engagement für unsere Werte gewinnst du das Vertrauen unserer Klienten und erzielst im Team Ergebnisse, die echte Veränderung bewirken.
In direkter Zusammenarbeit mit unseren Klienten gelingt es dir, gemeinsam mit ihnen Probleme zu lösen, Strategien zu verfeinern und Transformationen umzusetzen. Indem du unsere Klienten mit den richtigen Tools und Insights ausstattest, sorgst du dafür, dass unsere Projekte auch nach Abschluss zu Innovationen und Verbesserungen führen und nachhaltig Wirkung entfalten. title: Fellow - McKinsey Tech & AI
whoYouWillWorkWith:
Driving lasting impact and building long-term capabilities with our clients is not easy work. You are the kind of person who thrives in a high performance/high reward culture - doing hard things, picking yourself up when you stumble, and having the resilience to try another way forward.
In return for your drive, determination, and curiosity, we'll provide the resources, mentorship, and opportunities you need to become a stronger leader faster than you ever thought possible. Your colleagues—at all levels—will invest deeply in your development, just as much as they invest in delivering exceptional results for clients. Every day, you'll receive apprenticeship, coaching, and exposure that will accelerate your growth in ways you won’t find anywhere else.
When you join us, you will have:
  • Continuous learning: Our learning and apprenticeship culture, backed by structured programs, is all about helping you grow while creating an environment where feedback is clear, actionable, and focused on your development. The real magic happens when you take the input from others to heart and embrace the fast-paced learning experience, owning your journey.
  • A voice that matters: From day one, we value your ideas and contributions. You’ll make a tangible impact by offering innovative ideas and practical solutions, all while upholding our unwavering commitment to ethics and integrity. We not only encourage diverse perspectives, but they are critical in driving us toward the best possible outcomes.
  • Global community: With colleagues across 65+ countries and over 100 different nationalities, our firm’s diversity fuels creativity and helps us come up with the best solutions for our clients. Plus, you’ll have the opportunity to learn from exceptional colleagues with diverse backgrounds and experiences.
  • World-class benefits: On top of a competitive salary (based on your location, experience, and skills), we provide a comprehensive benefits package to enable holistic well-being for you and your family.
whatYouWillDo:
You’ll work in teams of typically 3 - 5 consultants, playing an active role in all aspects of client engagement.  
This includes gathering and analyzing information, formulating and testing hypotheses, and developing and communicating recommendations.  You’ll also have the opportunity to present results to client management and implement recommendations in collaboration with client team members.
You will receive exceptional training as well as frequent coaching and mentoring from colleagues on their teams.  This support includes a Partner from your local office or practice assigned to you to help guide your career as well as several weeks of formal training in your first two years.  Additionally, you’ll receive guidance and support from your local office or practice in the selection of client projects, helping you to develop your skills and build your network.
While all consultants develop specialized knowledge and a focused program as they progress with McKinsey, most are initially very broad in their focus, meaning they do not need specific industry or functional expertise to be successful. For consultants who join McKinsey as experienced professionals, this can mean building on previous knowledge or developing unique experience in an area that is completely new.
When you join McKinsey as a Fellow, you are joining a firm that will challenge you and invest heavily in your professional development. In this role you will have the opportunity to work on teams and help the best organizations in the world - across the private, public, and social sectors - solve some of their most difficult problems. whatYouWillDo:

Dabei handelt es sich um einige der einflussreichsten Organisationen weltweit, von Fortune-500- und DAX-Unternehmen bis hin zu innovativen Start-ups. Bei uns wirst du gefordert – und gefördert. title: Fellow - Young Leaders Program
whoYouWillWorkWith:
Driving lasting impact and building long-term capabilities with our clients is not easy work. You are the kind of person who thrives in a high performance/high reward culture - doing hard things, picking yourself up when you stumble, and having the resilience to try another way forward.
In return for your drive, determination, and curiosity, we'll provide the resources, mentorship, and opportunities you need to become a stronger leader faster than you ever thought possible. Your colleagues—at all levels—will invest deeply in your development, just as much as they invest in delivering exceptional results for clients. Every day, you'll receive apprenticeship, coaching, and exposure that will accelerate your growth in ways you won’t find anywhere else.
When you join us, you will have:
  • Continuous learning: Our learning and apprenticeship culture, backed by structured programs, is all about helping you grow while creating an environment where feedback is clear, actionable, and focused on your development. The real magic happens when you take the input from others to heart and embrace the fast-paced learning experience, owning your journey.
  • A voice that matters: From day one, we value your ideas and contributions. You’ll make a tangible impact by offering innovative ideas and practical solutions, all while upholding our unwavering commitment to ethics and integrity. We not only encourage diverse perspectives, but they are critical in driving us toward the best possible outcomes.
  • Global community: With colleagues across 65+ countries and over 100 different nationalities, our firm’s diversity fuels creativity and helps us come up with the best solutions for our clients. Plus, you’ll have the opportunity to learn from exceptional colleagues with diverse backgrounds and experiences.
  • World-class benefits: On top of a competitive salary (based on your location, experience, and skills), we provide a comprehensive benefits package to enable holistic well-being for you and your family.
whatYouWillDo:
You will work in teams of typically 3-5 consultants, playing an active role in all aspects of the client’s engagement.  
This includes gathering and analyzing information, formulating and testing hypotheses, and developing and communicating recommendations. During some engagements you will also present results to client management and implement recommendations in collaboration with client team members. 
You will gain new skills and build on the strengths you bring to the firm. Fellows receive exceptional training as well as frequent coaching and mentoring from colleagues on their teams. This support includes a partner from your local office or practice assigned to you to help guide your career as well as formal training. Additionally, you will receive guidance and support from your local office in the selection of client projects, helping you to develop your skills and build your network.
You will be based in our Nairobi office and may also have an opportunity to work in other offices across Africa.
The Young Leadership Program (YLP) is a two-year full-time consulting program that develops exceptional young local Kenyan talent into real leaders. You will work as part of a client project team, collaborating with colleagues and clients to solve their toughest business problems. At the end of the program, high-performing fellows progress into a business analyst role.
To apply, please submit:A one-page CV, indicating your cumulative university GPA or ranking and high school mean grade.
yourBackground:
• Undergraduate or master's degree with an excellent record of academic achievement
  • Less than 1 year of continuous work experience in any industry
  • Proven record of leadership through extracurricular activities and/or in a work setting
  • Exceptional analytical and quantitative problem-solving skills
  • Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment
  • Ability to communicate complex ideas effectively, both verbally and in writing, in English

When you join us, you will have:
  • Continuous learning: Our learning and apprenticeship culture, backed by structured programs, is all about helping you grow while creating an environment where feedback is clear, actionable, and focused on your development. The real magic happens when you take the input from others to heart and embrace the fast-paced learning experience, owning your journey.
  • A voice that matters: From day one, we value your ideas and contributions.   • Global community: With colleagues across 65+ countries and over 100 different nationalities, our firm’s diversity fuels creativity and helps us come up with the best solutions. Plus, you’ll have the opportunity to learn from exceptional colleagues with diverse backgrounds and experiences.

whatYouWillDo:
You will be a core member of our frontline IT support operation, providing high-quality technical support to an internal audience and owning the end-to-end resolution of the cases you receive.
You will independently troubleshoot and resolve the majority of incoming cases across Windows 11 and macOS, Microsoft 365 applications (e.g., Outlook, Teams, OneDrive, SharePoint), identity and access (e.g., MFA, password resets, account lockouts), network connectivity (Wi-Fi, VPN, DNS), mobile devices (iOS and Android) and hardware (laptops, peripherals and mobile phones). Working through email, chat and phone, you will manage your own ticket queue in our ITSM platform, adhere to your schedule, balance incoming volume against open cases, and escalate to GHD Analysts when an issue requires deeper expertise, with clear documentation of the steps already taken.
You will use the knowledge base as your primary source for solutions and actively help keep it accurate and up to date, documenting new issues and fixes as they arise. Beyond daily operations, you will participate in small team projects by sharing ideas and taking ownership of specific tasks, collaborate with internal IT service and product teams, support the testing of new technology and hardware releases in our technical labs, and take part in activities that promote a collaborative team environment.
Your work will directly shape how McKinsey colleagues experience technology. By resolving issues quickly and consistently delivering highly satisfying support, you will help colleagues stay focused on delivering impact to clients and play a key role in maintaining the firm's operational excellence.
You will be based in San Jose as part of our Global Helpdesk (GHD) team, a pivotal group within McKinsey's global IT organization. This team supports internal consultants and staff by troubleshooting and resolving a wide variety of IT needs, predominantly via email and chat. Your role is the foundation of our support model and offers a clear development path toward more specialized and senior roles within Global Helpdesk.
yourBackground:
• Technical degree, diploma or ongoing university studies in Information Technology, Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
  • 1+ year of experience in IT support, service desk or a customer-facing technical role is preferred
  • Familiarity with an ITSM / ticketing tool (e.g., ServiceNow) and working toward service level targets is a plus
  • Solid working knowledge of Windows 11 and macOS, including configuration, updates, user profiles and common OS-level troubleshooting
  • Hands-on experience with Microsoft 365 applications (Outlook, Teams, OneDrive, SharePoint) and common account issues such as MFA, password resets and sign-in problems
  • Good understanding of networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, Wi-Fi) and VPN connectivity troubleshooting
  • Knowledge of mobile devices (iOS and Android); familiarity with device management tools (e.g., Intune or Jamf) is a plus
  • Ability to diagnose laptop, peripheral and mobile phone hardware issues and guide users through resolution
  • Ability to manage a personal ticket queue, prioritize incoming volume and maintain schedule adherence in a fast-paced environment
  • Distinctive customer orientation combined with a strong sense of ownership, consistently delivering a high-quality support experience
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English with the ability to explain technical solutions clearly to non-technical users

title: Junior Practice Specialist - Manufacturing
whoYouWillWorkWith:

Your colleagues—at all levels—will invest deeply in your development, just as much as they invest in delivering exceptional results for clients. whatYouWillDo:
In this role, you will make an important contribution to the analysis, design and implementation of business performance approaches, developing tailor-made solutions and working closely with clients to ensure positive impact and sustainable results.
This includes gathering and analyzing information, formulating and testing hypotheses, and developing recommendations for presentation to client management. From there, you will implement those recommendations with client team members.
In addition, you will work in cooperation with our worldwide network of consultants to shape McKinsey's thinking in this area, continuously developing your own knowledge, as well as that of the firm. You’ll also gain new skills and build on the strengths you bring to the firm.
Consultants receive exceptional training as well as frequent coaching and mentoring from colleagues on their teams.
You will work with colleagues and clients to build sustainable value through delivering distinctive operations expertise.
Our Operations practice assists our clients in solving complex operational challenges. Blending strategic thinking with hands-on practicality, our teams of consultants and experts work to develop and implement operational strategies that solve our clients' most critical problems.
We will accelerate your development as a leader to create positive, enduring change in the world.
You will be based in our Tokyo or Osaka office as part of McKinsey’s Operations practice in Japan.

In return for your drive, determination, and curiosity, we'll provide the resources, mentorship, and opportunities you need to become a stronger leader faster than you ever thought possible. Your colleagues—at all levels—will invest deeply in your development, just as much as they invest in delivering exceptional results for clients. Every day, you'll receive apprenticeship, coaching, and exposure that will accelerate your growth in ways you won’t find anywhere else.
When you join us, you will have:
  • Continuous learning: Our learning and apprenticeship culture, backed by structured programs, is all about helping you grow while creating an environment where feedback is clear, actionable, and focused on your development. The real magic happens when you take the input from others to heart and embrace the fast-paced learning experience, owning your journey.
  • A voice that matters: From day one, we value your ideas and contributions. whatYouWillDo:
You will spend a significant part (~70% to 80%) of your time working onsite as part of consulting teams helping solve complex client problems in product development domain.
Your work majorly includes (and is not limited to) helping client teams estimate product cost based on clean sheet costing (and hence design a low cost product), rationalizing product design based on competitive teardown analysis and customer insights, working on new product development arena reducing new product development time, cost and quality attributes, carrying on survey to understand improvement aspects of the organization to support an efficient and effective product development and improving thereof to build a sustainable capability for the R&D organization for clients, etc.
The remaining time (~20% to 30%) will be spent on developing cutting-edge knowledge related to the Product Development (PD) domain and in delivering specialized remote services to clients.
You will focus on product development & design across industries. You will be expected to work on various product development engagements, provide expert client service by way of clean sheet costing, cost saving ideas/lever identification, and product teardown analysis.
You will also be required to support development and maintenance of various practice knowledge initiatives (build firm’s knowledge on product development related topics). This is a global role (cross geography, cross industry) and would work well for those who truly envision themselves growing into ‘experts’ within the PD domain.
yourBackground:
• Engineering degree (Mechanical, Automobile, Electrical, Production, Electronics). In addition to an Engineering degree, an MBA from a school with a specialization in Operations will be an added advantage
  • 1+ years of experience in should costing of parts or systems under procurement / R&D functions at OEM or Tier 1 (systems suppliers); prior experience in a multi-national environment is desirable
  • Strong analytical and quantitative problem-solving skills, including the ability to disaggregate complex cost structures, identify root causes and drivers, and propose optimization solutions
  • Proven experience building or using bottom-up cost models; familiarity with research-based modeling (e.g., process parameters, cycle times, material utilization, yields) is highly valued
  • Proficient in reading engineering drawings and technical specifications
  • Knowledge of the manufacturing process of various categories (OEM/Tier1/Tier 2)
  • Excellent problem-solving skills, including the ability to disaggregate issues, identify root causes and recommend solutions
  • Flexibility, patience and understanding of fluid, demanding, and unstructured environments, where priorities evolve constantly, and methodologies are regularly challenged
  • Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment, interact effectively with members from all levels in McKinsey and client organizations, with strong communication skills
  • Good written and verbal communication skills. Fluent in both written and spoken English

whoYouWillWorkWith:

whatYouWillDo:

So trägst du dazu bei, dass McKinsey einen bedeutenden Unterschied in verschiedenen Branchen und der Gesellschaft leisten kann.

title: Pricing Solution Delivery Senior Analyst - Growth, Marketing & Sales
whoYouWillWorkWith:
Driving lasting impact and building long-term capabilities with our clients is not easy work. You are the kind of person who thrives in a high performance/high reward culture - doing hard things, picking yourself up when you stumble, and having the resilience to try another way forward.
In return for your drive, determination, and curiosity, we'll provide the resources, mentorship, and opportunities you need to become a stronger leader faster than you ever thought possible. Your colleagues—at all levels—will invest deeply in your development, just as much as they invest in delivering exceptional results for clients. Every day, you'll receive apprenticeship, coaching, and exposure that will accelerate your growth in ways you won’t find anywhere else.
When you join us, you will have:
  • Continuous learning: Our learning and apprenticeship culture, backed by structured programs, is all about helping you grow while creating an environment where feedback is clear, actionable, and focused on your development. The real magic happens when you take the input from others to heart and embrace the fast-paced learning experience, owning your journey.
  • A voice that matters: From day one, we value your ideas and contributions. You’ll make a tangible impact by offering innovative ideas and practical solutions, all while upholding our unwavering commitment to ethics and integrity. We not only encourage diverse perspectives, but they are critical in driving us toward the best possible outcomes.
  • Global community: With colleagues across 65+ countries and over 100 different nationalities, our firm’s diversity fuels creativity and helps us come up with the best solutions for our clients. Plus, you’ll have the opportunity to learn from exceptional colleagues with diverse backgrounds and experiences.
  • World-class benefits: On top of a competitive salary (based on your location, experience, and skills), we provide a comprehensive benefits package to enable holistic well-being for you and your family.
whatYouWillDo:
You will be working in one of our North American offices as part of our Growth, Marketing & Sales practice.
You will: work in teams to tackle key strategic, organizational, and operational challenges faced by our clients; collaborate within a team to deliver capabilities that transform how our clients establish and execute their merchandising and/or pricing strategy; work with our clients who benefit from our collective experience in bringing the best of McKinsey strategy together with our best-in-class; and collaborate with client business and technical stakeholders to deliver end to end solutions.
Your strong sense of ownership, accountability, and desire to deliver high quality end-to-end intuitive and impactful analytic products using advanced data driven approaches will serve you well.
You will also work within a cross-functional team of data scientists, solution analysts, data engineers and product experts to execute solution deployments, analysis, and/or upgrades. Your work provides exposure to multiple client business and technical leaders. You will master the analytics and methodology embedded into the solutions and the data concepts related to the sector domains, and develop a deep understanding of the domain/function (across pricing, promotions, loyalty, trade promotion management and/or assortment), to clearly articulate the benefits of Periscope® to clients, both external and internal, and how they are implemented in an organization. This involves engaging with client sponsors on a regular basis to discuss how to drive user adoption and helping them with questions they might have regarding the solution and its impact to their business.
Periscope® by McKinsey is the technology backbone of McKinsey’s Growth, Marketing & Sales Practice. Founded in 2007, it combines world-leading intellectual property, prescriptive analytics and cloud-based tools, with expert support and training. This unique combination drives revenue growth - now, and in the future. We enable our clients to make better commercial decisions faster by uncovering actionable insights.
Periscope® has a presence in 28 locations across six continents, 35+ capabilities, and a team of 800+ technology and business professionals and 300+ experts. To learn more about how Periscopes® solutions and experts are helping businesses continually drive better performance, visit Periscope's site.
yourBackground:
• Bachelor’s degree in business or in engineering (MBA is a plus)
  • 2+ years of experience in the field of consulting, analytic pricing, merchandising and/or technology delivery
  • Experience working with analytical topics, data science, data visualization tools and statistics, within CPG, and/or retail organizations preferred
  • Experience working with product owners, project managers, business analysts, SMEs and data teams to collaboratively design, configure and deliver solutions
  • Experience working on large scale projects and working with multiple business stakeholders in a matrixed environment to influence decision-making
  • Able to articulate solutions to stakeholders with different degrees of business and technical knowledge
  • Able to work well in a highly entrepreneurial environment with teams and with client sponsors on a regular basis
  • Proven problem-solving skills with the ability to quickly process complex information and present it in a clear and simple manner
  • Experience working on a team and collaborating with junior resources. Able to identify requirements and translate into actionable design documentation
  • Solid understanding and hands-on experience working with large data sources and proficiency in the latest cloud based advanced tools and platforms
  • Comfortable navigating ambiguity; ability and experience to make decisions based on assumptions, data-led hypothesis testing and pros/cons analysis

You don't need to be an AI/ML specialist, but AI coding agents and assistants are a core part of how you design, build, test, debug, document, and operate software - and you bring the judgment to know when to rely on them, how to verify their output, and how to raise the bar for AI-assisted work across a team. yourBackground:

title: Software Engineer - QuantumBlack, AI by McKinsey
whoYouWillWorkWith:
Driving lasting impact and building long-term capabilities with our clients is not easy work. You are the kind of person who thrives in a high performance/high reward culture - doing hard things, picking yourself up when you stumble, and having the resilience to try another way forward.
In return for your drive, determination, and curiosity, we'll provide the resources, mentorship, and opportunities you need to become a stronger leader faster than you ever thought possible. whatYouWillDo:
As a Software Engineer, you will collaborate with a global network of technologists, designers, and strategists to help clients transform their businesses through innovative digital solutions.
In this hands-on role, you’ll develop cutting-edge products, mentor client teams, and shape engineering cultures while growing your expertise across diverse industries and technologies. 
In this role, you will work hands-on with clients across industries to bring their digital ambitions to life. You will develop software products and services from the ground up while coaching and mentoring client teams on engineering best practices, user-centric design, and Agile values. By co-creating with clients and their leadership, you’ll help build not only cutting-edge products but also the technical capabilities and cultures needed to sustain them. 
Your work will drive meaningful change for clients and their industries. You will participate in cross-functional problem-solving sessions with client leaders, shaping their digital strategies and delivering solutions that go beyond the product itself. At McKinsey, you’ll grow as a technologist and leader. You’ll work across diverse industries and technologies, learning something new with every project. With opportunities to contribute to digital strategies, build impactful products, and mentor others, you’ll have the freedom to chart your own path and grow in the areas that excite you most.

Driving lasting impact and building long-term capabilities with our clients is not easy work. You are the kind of person who thrives in a high performance/high reward culture - doing hard things, picking yourself up when you stumble, and having the resilience to try another way forward.
In return for your drive, determination, and curiosity, we'll provide the resources, mentorship, and opportunities you need to become a stronger leader faster than you ever thought possible. Your colleagues—at all levels—will invest deeply in your development, just as much as they invest in delivering exceptional results for clients. Every day, you'll receive apprenticeship, coaching, and exposure that will accelerate your growth in ways you won’t find anywhere else.
When you join us, you will have:
  • Continuous learning: Our learning and apprenticeship culture, backed by structured programs, is all about helping you grow while creating an environment where feedback is clear, actionable, and focused on your development. The real magic happens when you take the input from others to heart and embrace the fast-paced learning experience, owning your journey.
  • A voice that matters: From day one, we value your ideas and contributions. You’ll make a tangible impact by offering innovative ideas and practical solutions, all while upholding our unwavering commitment to ethics and integrity. We not only encourage diverse perspectives, but they are critical in driving us toward the best possible outcomes.
  • Global community: With colleagues across 65+ countries and over 100 different nationalities, our firm’s diversity fuels creativity and helps us come up with the best solutions for our clients. Plus, you’ll have the opportunity to learn from exceptional colleagues with diverse backgrounds and experiences.
  • World-class benefits: On top of a competitive salary (based on your location, experience, and skills), we provide a comprehensive benefits package to enable holistic well-being for you and your family.
whatYouWillDo:
As a Sophomore Summer Business Analyst Intern, you will join a client service team for 8-10 weeks, contributing to workstreams to help solve some of the toughest challenges our clients face.
And these aren’t just any clients—they're some of the most influential organizations around, from Fortune 500 giants to innovative startups. You will go the extra mile, delivering solutions that solve immediate problems and drive long-term change. We’ll rely on your judgment and integrity to ensure our recommendations are effective and long-lasting.
You will take on a role that goes beyond advising. You’ll be at the heart of the action—helping to uncover the true challenges behind a client’s strategy and creating actionable plans that drive real change. Working alongside clients and other McKinsey colleagues, you’ll combine research, analyzing data, interviews, and brainstorming to generate fresh insights and breakthrough solutions. Your commitment to our values will be crucial in earning our clients' trust and delivering results that matter.
As you collaborate directly with clients, you’ll help them solve problems, refine strategies, and implement transformations. By equipping them with the tools and knowledge to continue innovating and improving after we’ve left, you’ll ensure the impact of our work endures. In doing so, you’ll uphold McKinsey’s commitment to making a meaningful difference in the industries and communities we serve.
yourBackground:
• Student in or entering the second year of an undergraduate degree; with an anticipated graduation date between December 2028 and August 2029
  • Self-identify as a member of a historically underrepresented group in the management consulting profession including Black and/or part of Indigenous groups in Canada
  • Excellent organizational capabilities, including the ability to initiate tasks independently and see them through to completion
  • Proficient in rational decision making based on data, facts, and logical reasoning
  • Ability to create work product-focused materials / outputs, which may include PowerPoint decks, Excel models, articles, or other written deliverables
  • Exceptional time management to meet your responsibilities in a complex and largely autonomous work environment
  • Ability to work or attend meetings outside of traditional business hours or take on projects with limited or no notice at times
  • Ability to travel to and work in varying environments that may be challenging and/or not accessible (e.g., factories, hospitals, mines)
  • Strong communication skills, both verbal and written, in English and local office language(s), with the ability to adjust your style to suit different perspectives and seniority levels

whatYouWillDo:
You will serve as a thought partner to client service leadership and consulting teams, helping turn complex ideas and insights into distinctive communications for senior Japanese business audiences.
You will bring deep communication expertise to the firm’s most strategic client and office priorities.
You will combine communication strategy with hands-on content creation—shaping the message, storyline, writing, charting, and overall craft of client, executive, and external materials. Your work may include bespoke books, white papers, articles, thought leadership, and other high-impact content, as well as the localization of global firm assets for Japan.
You will independently lead communication workstreams from concept through delivery, collaborating across the Client Hub community, including Reach & Engagement, Client Activation, the CEO Special Initiative, and Board Excellence. You will also use and help build AI-enabled tools and workflows to improve the quality and speed of content creation.
Your key responsibilities will include:
Communication Strategy and Thought Partnership- Serve as a trusted thought partner to client service leadership, consulting teams, and initiative leaders. Define the communication objective, audience, core message, storyline, format, and tone to make complex ideas clear, relevant, and compelling.
Client, External, and Visual Communication- Develop high-quality Japanese-language materials for client, executive, and external audiences. Shape the storyline, writing, page architecture, charts, and exhibits so each communication lands a clear “so what” and supports decision making.
Signature and Long-Form Content- Lead substantial communication products such as bespoke books, white papers, reports, articles, executive perspectives, and thought leadership. Draw out expert insights, synthesize research, structure the narrative, and drive the content to a polished final product.
Strategic Initiatives and Client Hub Collaboration- Support priority initiatives such as the CEO Special Initiative and Board Excellence, while partnering across Reach & Engagement, Client Activation, and other capabilities to bring the best of the firm to client and external audiences.
Japanese Market Adaptation- Adapt global firm knowledge and content for Japanese audiences, going beyond translation to ensure the business context, examples, narrative, tone, and level of detail resonate locally while preserving the original strategic intent.
End-to-End Delivery and Innovation- Own complex communication assignments from brief to delivery, managing contributors, reviews, approvals, and specialist resources. Apply generative AI and help build AI-enabled tools or workflows that improve content quality, speed, and scalability while maintaining firm standards.
yourBackground:

  • 5+ years of relevant experience in communication strategy, content development, thought leadership, journalism, editorial, corporate communications, or a related field, with experience leading complex content or communication projects end to end.
  • Communication Strategy and Business Judgment: Ability to quickly understand complex business topics and translate objectives and insights into a clear communication approach across audience, proposition, message, storyline, format, and tone.
  • Demonstrated fluency in using generative AI to improve research, synthesis, ideation, drafting, editing, localization, charting, and quality assurance; able to build or help develop AI-enabled tools and workflows that elevate content quality and speed
  • Confidence and credibility to work with Partners, Senior Partners, client service leaders, consultants, and experts; able to ask incisive questions, provide constructive challenge, and build alignment around the final communication
  • Strong problem-solving, project-management, and collaboration skills, with the ability to lead ambiguous workstreams independently, manage multiple contributors and reviews, and deliver rigorous work in a fast-paced environment
  • Ability to operate with a firm-wide, top-management perspective, taking end-to-end ownership, and treating firm and client priorities as their own. Proactively identifies what is needed, makes sound judgments, and pioneers new approaches rather than waiting for direction
  • Exceptional Japanese writing and storytelling skills, with strong judgment in headlines, page architecture, charts, and exhibits. A portfolio demonstrating original authorship and substantive content shaping is required.
  • Native-level language skills in Japanese with exceptional writing skills for senior business audiences; business fluency level language skills in English to work with global colleagues, experts, and source materials.
